properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 is this codebase's default digest everywhere: user/admin password hashing (WindidUtility.php:20 md5(md5($password).$salt) is the phpwind password scheme; AdminFounderService, PwForumDm, PwUser random passwords, installer admin password at IndexController.php:634), payment-gateway signature verification (AlipayController:46, TenpayController:33, Pay99billController:39, PwAlipay:88, PwTenpay:70, PwBill:69 — MD5 keyed MACs over payment callbacks, forgeable on collision), CSRF/verify-code/invite

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored phpseclib RC4 implementation shipped in the tree. Net/SSH2.php offers 'arcfour' as an optional session cipher (live use if negotiated), Net/SSH1 supports the RC4 cipher, Crypt/Random.php:115-116 uses a Crypt_RC4 keystream as a randomness fallback. Available in the shipped library; no first-party application call site found, but the algorithms ship with the image. Changeable here by upgrading/removing phpseclib or restricting SSH2 cipher negotiation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 3DES is real in two layers: the vendored phpseclib library (Crypt_TripleDES implementation + SSH1/SSH2 3des-cbc/3des-ctr session ciphers + DES-EDE3-CBC private-key encryption in Crypt_RSA, keyed by an MD5-derived symkey) and the application's own WindMcryptDes wrapper (wind/security/WindMcryptDes.php) running MCRYPT_3DES in ECB mode. 64-bit block → Sweet32; superseded by AES-256-GCM. Two prose-comment false matches at RSA.php:764/765 were rejected; the other 36 sites are live code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: phpwind's primary user-credential hashing is fast MD5 (salted double-MD5 in WindidUtility, unsalted MD5 for admin founder/installer/forum passwords), used for login verification, password reset, forum access passwords and cookie pwd-codes. phpseclib derives DES/3DES keys from MD5 for encrypted private keys. Migration: bcrypt/Argon2 for passwords, scrypt/PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 or ML-KEM-era KDFs for key encryption.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Single DES (56-bit effective key, 64-bit block) — broken with classical hardware since 1998, so this is an outstanding defect rather than a PQ-migration item. Three clusters: (1) the vendored phpseclib Crypt_DES implementation itself (DES.php:375/448 open the mcrypt MCRYPT_DES module); (2) phpseclib RSA.php:787 'DES-CBC' support for decrypting legacy PEM private keys; (3) the first-party wind framework crypto layer — WindMcryptCbc.php:32/51 and WindSecurity.php:71/91 encrypt/decrypt via mcrypt_c

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1 appears as: API request signature in the Laiwang chat integration (first-party, security purpose), ssh-dss signature verification in vendored phpseclib SSH2 (inherent to DSA), vendored Hash/Random library surface, and a non-security MIME Message-ID generator in WindMail. The Laiwang signature is the first-party security-relevant use.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SSH transport key exchange in the vendored phpseclib Net/SSH2.php client the app bundles; any SSH session it opens can negotiate these DH groups. Group1-sha1 is 1024-bit (classically breakable today); neither offers PQ protection.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored phpseclib Net/SSH2 both advertises diffie-hellman-group1-sha1 in its key-exchange algorithm list (line 728) and implements it in the KEX switch (line 926). Group 1 is the 1024-bit Oakley group with SHA-1 — classically weak and quantum-vulnerable DH. Observable library capability; replaceable by upgrading phpseclib. No first-party call site restricts the KEX list, so a server offering only strong methods is fine, but the client will accept the weak one.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two real curl configurations with hostname verification off: checkssl.php is a standalone SSL-check utility that also disables VERIFYPEER (see ALG-a5f0697a); WindHttpCurl.php is the wind framework's curl transfer layer, so every outgoing HTTPS request made through it accepts any certificate that chains to a trusted CA regardless of hostname. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: checkssl.php is a standalone diagnostic/utility script in the web root that disables both peer verification (this line) and hostname verification (ALG-f9de03f1), making any HTTPS fetch it performs trivially interceptable. It is first-party code; fixable by deleting the script or enabling verification.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored phpseclib's unauthenticated modes: CTR is used by SSH2 (aes128-ctr/aes256-ctr/3des-ctr session ciphers, where the SSH protocol applies HMAC separately) and by Crypt_Random as its fallback CSPRNG engine (AES-CTR keyed from mt_rand-derived entropy). CBC-without-EtM and CTR-without-MAC in library APIs remain malleable when callers use them standalone; the wind framework's wrappers (WindMcryptDes/WindMcryptCbc) do exactly that.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Unauthenticated CBC without a MAC. In the vendored phpseclib, CBC is the DEFAULT mode for TripleDES (var $mode = CRYPT_DES_MODE_CBC) and supported throughout AES/Rijndael/DES/TripleDES — used by Net/SSH2 session encryption and RSA private-key PEM encryption when negotiated. In first-party code the wind framework's own crypto layer (WindMcryptCbc, WindSecurity) encrypts with mcrypt DES-CBC (no MAC anywhere in the file) deriving the key with md5(). Changeable here: move to an AEAD (AES-256-GCM) or

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: phpseclib's block ciphers default to a literal IV: Crypt_DES and Crypt_TripleDES initialize var $iv/$encryptIV/$decryptIV to eight NUL bytes and Crypt_Rijndael to the empty string (zero-padded on use). A caller that encrypts in CBC without setIV() runs with an all-zero IV — deterministic and key-independent. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Finite-field SSH key agreement in the vendored phpseclib Net/SSH2.php. PQ migration would need an ML-KEM/hybrid KEX method (modern OpenSSH mlkem768x25519), which this library version does not implement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored phpseclib Net/SSH2 supports ssh-dss host and user keys (advertised in the public-key algorithm list at line 734, verified/signed at 2193) — DSA with SHA-1, quantum-vulnerable via Shor and fragile against nonce reuse. Library capability; no first-party restriction of the algorithm list was found. Migration target ML-DSA / Ed25519 keys.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SSH session ciphers offered by the vendored phpseclib Net/SSH2 client; CBC variants are used without encrypt-then-MAC, which is itself a weakness of this library generation.

properties.value: phpseclib's AES block cipher engine (also backs the aes128/aes256 SSH session ciphers). Mode and key size are caller-controlled, so the AES-128 floor is the honest default grade.
